message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Pull actions

on:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: "ubuntu-latest"
    name: Validate
    steps:
        - uses: "actions/checkout@v6"

        - name: HACS validation
          uses: "hacs/action@main"
          with:
            category: "integration"
            ignore: brands

        - name: Hassfest validation
          uses: "home-assistant/actions/hassfest@master"

  style:
    runs-on: "ubuntu-latest"
    name: Check style formatting
    steps:
        - uses: "actions/checkout@v6"
        - uses: "actions/setup-python@v6"
          with:
            python-version: "3.x"
        - run: python3 -m pip install black
        - run: black .

  tests:
    runs-on: "ubuntu-latest"
    name: Run tests
    steps:
      - name: Check out code from GitHub
        uses: "actions/checkout@v6"
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: "actions/setup-python@v6"
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('requirements_test.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install requirements
        run: python3 -m pip install -r requirements_test.txt
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest \
            -qq \
            --timeout=300 \
            --durations=10 \
            -n auto \
            --cov custom_components.irrigation_unlimited \
            -o console_output_style=count \
            -p no:sugar \
            tests",
  "rationale": "The tests job reinstalls Python dependencies from requirements_test.txt on every pull request run with no dependency cache, so repeated pip fetching is measurable and the cache input (requirements_test.txt plus runner OS) is available. This matches the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (dependency_cache mechanism), which reports a modest VM-time reduction and has a matching measured experiment adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cache/pip keyed on the dependency file. The change is minimal: one cache step is inserted before pip install in the tests job only. All existing jobs, steps, permissions, triggers, and test coverage are preserved; no secrets, publishing, deployment, or new network access is added, and no existing cache equivalent exists in the workflow.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
